## Verdict

**Heronry** costs least for a team of 45, at **$405 per month**. All three vendors have minimums at or below 45 seats, so every option bills for exactly 45 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rates directly. Heronry's $9 rate undercuts Juno Board by $270 per month and Cygnus Flow by $540 per month.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $15 | 40 |
| Cygnus Flow | $21 | 1 |
| Heronry | $9 | 10 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the greater of 45 (team size) or the vendor minimum. No minimum binds here.

- **Heronry:** minimum 10 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $9 = **$405 per month**.
- **Juno Board:** minimum 40 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $15 = **$675 per month**.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 1 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $21 = **$945 per month**.

Spread between cheapest and dearest: $540 per month, or $6,480 per year. Heronry is 40% cheaper than Juno Board and 57% cheaper than Cygnus Flow.

## Risks

Minimums are inactive at this headcount but become live if the team shrinks. Below 40 people Juno Board still bills $600 (40 × $15), so its effective rate rises; Heronry's floor of 10 seats costs $90, and Cygnus Flow has no practical floor. At very small sizes the ordering could change, though Heronry's $9 rate keeps it cheapest down to 10 seats.

Growth does not reorder the ranking. All three scale linearly above 45 seats, so Heronry stays cheapest at any larger size on list price, and the absolute gap widens by $6 and $12 per added seat against Juno Board and Cygnus Flow respectively.

This is a price comparison only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security, or integrations, so the cheapest seat may not be a comparable product. All figures assume list pricing billed monthly as stated; annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees, and migration costs are not in the source and could change these totals.
